name: kubexporter-headlamp-plugin
description: Headlamp plugin for visualizing KubExporter OpenReports export statistics

scripts.package: rm -f *.tar.gz && headlamp-plugin package > /dev/null && tar xzf *.tar.gz && rm -f *.tar.gz && mv headlamp kubexporter && tar --sort=name --mtime='1970-01-01 00:00Z' --owner=0 --group=0 --numeric-owner -cf - kubexporter | gzip -n > kubexporter-headlamp-plugin-$(node -p "require('./package.json').version").tar.gz && rm -rf kubexporter && rm -f *.sha256 && sha256sum kubexporter-headlamp-plugin-*.tar.gz
